object.description: Read a document without figures; put figures/DOC-1.svg in place by hand and read; put figures/DOC-99.svg for an object that doesn't exist; add and then remove figures/DOC-0.svg between reads. Attach a figure to DOC-1 through Mellon, and, from a description already written by Mellon, attach a figure and change and restore a description in one step. Expected: an object has a figure exactly while figures/<object ID>.svg exists; the orphan file gives no object a figure; attaching writes figures/DOC-1.svg; the step's only changed file is the figure file, so the object file is unchanged.
